Name: Blast Seed
Description: Deals 2d6 Fire-Type damage to the Pokémon 1-tile in front when used. Can be thrown to deal 2d6 Fire-Type damage to the Pokémon it hits. When held, and you are damaged by a Fire-Type Move, it explodes and deals 2d6 Fire-Type Damage to the User.

Name: Vile Seed
Description: Damage taken from the next Move deals double damage.

Name: Heal Seed
Description: Heals all Status Conditions, fills Belly by 20.

Name: Hunger Seed
Description: Your Belly is as if you hadn’t eaten for 2 days.

Name: Plain Seed
Description: No effect. Appears when a Reviver Seed or Tiny Reviver Seed has been used.

Name: Quick Seed
Description: Raises Battle Movement by 2 for this Floor.

Name: Reviver Seed
Description: Revives fainted Pokémon, and you restore all PP. Becomes Plain Seed afterwards.

Name: Tiny Reviver Seed
Description: Revives fainted Pokémon. Becomes Plain Seed afterwards.

Name: Pure Seed
Description: Warps the Team to the next dungeon floor.

Name: Warp Seed
Description: Warps Pokémon to elsewhere on the Current Floor.
